verses.text: Ayik ix och winhaj Joacim yuninal winhaj Josías reyal t'a Judá, hata' ix lolon Jehová t'ayin Jeremías in tik.
Ix yalan icha tik: Ajanh tek'tek' t'a yamak'il in templo, tzalan masanil tas ix wal tik t'ayach t'a heb' aj Judá tzul och ejmelal t'a in templo tik. Malaj junok lolonel to max ala'.
Talaj scha yab' heb' t'ayach, syaktankan schuk b'eyb'al heb', tato icha chi', manhxo ol wak'b'at yahelal nab'il wuj wak'anb'at t'a yib'anh heb' yuj schuk b'eyb'al chi'.
Tzal t'a heb' to a in Jehová in swal t'a heb' icha tik: Yujto max he cha eyab' in k'ayb'ub'al swala', max he k'anab'ajej paxi,
max he cha eyab' he kachji yuj heb' in chekab', wach'chom tzijtum el ix in chekb'at heb', palta maj he k'anab'ajej heb',

yuj chi', icha wutejnak in kajnub' t'a Silo, icha chi' ol wutej jun templo tik. Ol wak'b'at katab' t'a yib'anh jun chonhab' tik t'a skal masanil juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol yib'anhk'inal, xchi Jehová, xa chi t'a heb'.
Ha heb' sacerdote, heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios yet' masanil heb' anima, ix yab' wal heb' walan juntzanh lolonel chi' t'a templo.
Ayik ix lajwi walan masanil tas ix schek Jehová wala', ix in syaman heb'. Ix yalan heb' t'ayin icha tik: Ol ach chamok.

¿Tas wal yuj tza tek'b'ej a b'a halan t'a sb'i Jehová to a jun stemplo tik lajan ol ajkan icha ajnak skajnub' t'a Silo? Tzalani to ol satel jun chonhab' tik, manhxa mach ol kajnaj t'ay, xa chi, xchi heb'. Masanil anima ix ja nhilnaj t'a yamak'il templo chi', ix oymaj heb' t'a in patik.
Ayik ix yab'an heb' yajal t'a Judá tas wan yuji chi', ix kot heb' t'a spalacio winh rey, ix jawi heb' t'a templo b'aj ay jun ak' puerta, hata' ix jawi k'ojan heb'.

Ix yalan heb' sacerdote yet' heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi' t'a heb' yajal yet' t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha jun winh tik smoj scham winh, yujto ix yal winh to ay yahelal ol ja t'a yib'anh ko chonhab' tik. Ha ex tik tzeyab'nhej tas syal winh chi', xchi heb'.
Ix walan t'a heb' yajal chi' yet' t'a heb' anima chi' icha tik: Ha Jehová ix chekan wal tas ix eyab' t'a spatik jun templo tik yet' t'a spatik ko chonhab' tik.
B'o'ek he b'eyb'al yet' tas tze k'ulej, k'anab'ajejek Jehová ko Diosal yik wach' manh ol yak'kot juntzanh yahelal toxo ix alchaj chi' t'a eyib'anh.
Ha in tik, ayin wal ek' t'a yol he k'ab', syalnhej he k'ulan tas tze nib'ej t'ayin.

Palta, ojtakejek wal el sik'lab'il: Tato a ex yet' heb' anima tik tzin he milchamok, ol och he mul yujto tze milcham junok mach malaj smul. Yujto wal yel, a Jehová ix chekan wal juntzanh lolonel tik, xin chi t'a heb'.

Yuj chi' ix yalan heb' yajal yet' heb' anima chi' t'a heb' sacerdote yet' t'a heb' syaloch sb'a schekab'ok Dios chi': Manh smojok scham jun winh tik, yujto ha t'a sb'i Jehová ko Diosal ix lolon winh t'ayonh, xchi heb'.
Ay juntzanh heb' yichamtak winakil chonhab' ix k'e wa'an, ix yalan heb' t'a heb' anima molanek' chi':

Ha t'a stiempo'al winhaj Ezequías sreyal Judá, a winhaj Miqueas aj Moreset ix lolon t'a sb'i Jehová t'a masanil heb' kajan t'a Judá, ix yalan winh icha tik: Ha Jehová Yajal t'a Smasanil tz'alan icha tik: Ha Sion tik ol kan yikok munlajel. Ha pax Jerusalén ol emkan lanhnajok, haxo jun tzalan b'aj ay templo tik, wayumtak ol ajok, xchi Jehová, xchi winh.

Palta tokwal ix miljicham winh yuj winhaj rey Ezequías chi' yet' pax yuj heb' anima. Anhej to ix xiw winh, ix tewi winh t'a Jehová. Yuj chi' majxo yak'kot yahelal Jehová toxo ix yal chi'. Tato sko milcham winhaj Jeremías tik, ol kik'kot yahelal t'a kib'anh, xchi heb'.

(Yet' pax winh schekab' Dios skuchan Urías yuninal winhaj Semaías, aj Quiriat-jearim, a winh ix lolon t'a sb'i Jehová t'a jun chonhab' tik yet' t'a juntzanhxo chonhab' ay t'a yol smakb'en, icha ix aj walan Jeremías in tik.

Ha winhaj rey Joacim yet' heb' ayoch yajalil yet'ok yet' heb' niwak yopisio, ix yab' heb' tas ix yal winh. Ix snib'ej winh rey chi' smilcham winh. Haxo yik ix yab'an winhaj Urías chi' tas yaji, ix xiwb'at winh, ix b'at winh elelal t'a Egipto.
Ix chekjib'at winhaj Elnatán yuninal winhaj Acbor yet' juntzanhxo heb' winh winak yuj winhaj rey Joacim t'a Egipto chi'.

Haton heb' winh ix b'at ik'ankot winhaj Urías chi', ix yak'anoch winh heb' t'a yol sk'ab' winh rey chi'. Ix yalan winh to smiljicham winh, syumjib'at sniwanil winh b'aj sb'atkan sniwanil heb' komon anima. Icha chi' ix aji.)
Palta a in Jeremías in tik, maj in ak'ji'och t'a yol sk'ab' heb' anima yik tzin smilancham heb', yujto a winhaj Ahicam yuninal winhaj Safán ix yak'och sb'a wet'ok.
